Who can replace a founder like Jensen Huang?

This week on Mixture of Experts, host David Zax is joined by Derek Robertson, Bri Kopecki and Kiyu Gabriel.

First, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang resigns after more than three decades leading a company whose long-term investments helped shape the AI industry. The panel discusses whether the long-term bets Huang made, from CUDA to high-bandwidth networking, can keep NVIDIA ahead without him.

Next, Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2, renewing questions about artificial general intelligence (AGI). A surprising demonstration of the model leads the panel into a debate about human creativity. If AI-generated art makes you feel something, does it matter who—or what—created it?

Finally, a special one-on-one conversation examines Confluent's Streamhouse announcement and what access to real-time business data could mean for AI agents.

All that and more on Mixtu
title: Jensen Huang exits NVIDIA & does Claude Fable 5.2 count as AGI?
